qualification_rule: Freeze only sleeves passing native position equivalence, all truncated-history prefix tests, signal-lag evidence, return identity, and deterministic rerun. A sleeve may not be qualified from performance alone.
scope_limits: No claim that the fixed ETF universe is survivorship-bias-free.
No claim that historical data are vintage point-in-time vendor snapshots.
No removal of historical strategy-selection contamination.
No live trading or capital deployment.
